description: Seal of Command Level 60 Talent 65 Mana Instant Requires Paladin Requires level 20 Gives the Paladin a chance to deal additional Holy damage equal to 70% of normal weapon damage. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Lasts 30 sec. Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy, instantly causing 69 to 73 Holy damage, 138 to 146 if the target is stunned or incapacitated. (1s cooldown)
name: Seal of Command
